result.reason: The clause adds most required concepts, including workmanlike performance, legal compliance, conformance, malicious-code protection, and corrective remedies. However, it does not implement the required warranty periods cleanly: the 12-month period runs from the Effective Date rather than delivery or performance and does not distinguish software from services, potentially shortening post-delivery coverage. The refund remedy is also limited to amounts relating to non-conforming services and may not cover defective software or other deliverables. The added Globix carveout and broad on-demand availability warranty are unrelated to the playbook requirement and materially alter other commercial terms. Drafting issues include the missing period in subsection (b), awkward punctuation, and ambiguity over which breaches the remedy covers.
